description.en: The ID of the desktop group.
Specifies whether to return deleted desktops.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。
- 默认值：10。
- 最大值：100。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries to return on a single page.

- Maximum value: 100.

- Default value: 10.

description.zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个。
description.en: The token that is used to start the next query. If this parameter is empty, all results are returned.

description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service.
